details: Bitcoin remained steady above the $80,000 mark on May 9, 2026, driven by significant institutional adoption and sustained demand for spot Bitcoin Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs). BNY Mellon announced plans to launch regulated Bitcoin and Ethereum custody services in Abu Dhabi, while BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) continues to see record inflows. Further legislative clarity in the US, particularly with the "CLARITY Act" set for a Senate Banking Committee session on May 14, is anticipated to solidify a definitive regulatory framework for digital tokens. Analysts suggest these developments could push Bitcoin towards a $250,000 valuation, despite ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East causing some investor caution.
title: Bitcoin holds above $80,000 as institutional adoption signals global finance shift.

details: The cryptocurrency market saw a recovery in confidence on May 9, 2026, partly fueled by growing optimism for a swift resolution to the Middle East conflict. Additionally, stronger-than-expected US Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) data, showing 115,000 new jobs against an estimated 65,000, indicated resilience in the US economy. While robust employment could lead to inflationary pressures and potentially a more aggressive stance from the Federal Reserve, current market expectations largely point towards stable interest rates through December 2026. However, a rising probability (over 20%) of a rate hike by early 2027 could impact risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, which are currently behaving as risk assets in the short term.
title: Middle East optimism and strong US jobs data boost crypto market confidence.
